name: 亮度梯度角度分析
algorithm: Luma Gradient Angle — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes luminance gradient angles for image forensic analysis following the rich model framework of Fridrich & Kodovsky (2012):

1. **梯度计算**: The luminance gradient vector is computed at each pixel using finite differences or Sobel operators: (∂I/∂x, ∂I/∂y). The gradient angle θ = arctan(∂I/∂y / ∂I/∂x) captures the local edge orientation.

2. **梯度AngleStatistics**: The distribution of gradient angles across the image is analyzed. Natural images show characteristic angle distributions shaped by scene content. The method extracts statistical features from the gradient angle histogram — moments, entropy, and directional energy ratios.

3. **局部梯度AnglePatterns**: Co-occurrence patterns of gradient angles between neighboring pixels are analyzed, similar to the rich model approach. Natural images show specific gradient angle co-occurrence patterns arising from smooth edge curves and continuous surfaces. AI artifacts disrupt these patterns.

4. **梯度Angle一致性**: The spatial consistency of gradient angles along edges is checked. Real edges show gradually varying gradient angles (smooth contours). AI-generated images may show abrupt angle changes along edges or gradient angle patterns inconsistent with the expected camera imaging pipeline.

5. **ForensicScorefrom梯度Features**: The gradient angle features (histogram statistics, co-occurrence patterns, consistency measures) are combined into a forensic score. Features are evaluated against models trained on natural vs. AI-generated images, following the rich model steganalysis framework adapted for AI detection.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： luma gradient angle 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
